newsitem.title: USA: Harken moving rig to Colombia well site.
newsitem.headline: Harken moving rig to Colombia well site.

text.p: Harken Energy Corp said Tuesday it has begun moving a drilling rig to the location of its Estero No. 1 well on what has been identified as the Palo Blanco Prospect.
Harken said it expects the rig will be ready to begin drilling within the next few days.

The Estero No. 1 well is expected to reach a depth of 9,100 feet and will take about 30 days to drill and another 20 days to test and evaluate, Harken said. The well should test five oil-prone zones prevalent in the Llanos Basin -- the Carbonera, Mirador, Guadalupe, Gacheta and Ubaque formations.

Parker Drilling Co has been contracted to drill the Estero No. 1 on a location in close proximity to existing pipeline and road infrastructure which should accelerate start-up of production should hydrocarbons be discovered.

During 1997, Harken said, "we plan to drill four exploratory prospects and have already identified enough wildcat prospects on other acreage to maintain this pace of exploratory drilling through 1999."
The company said it will also continue development of the Rio Negro prospect. The next development well, Torcaz No. 3, is planned to be drilled this quarter.
